source.author: verg
source.text: Dixit et adversos telum contorsit in hostis procurrens: sonitum dat stridula cornus et auras certa secat.
source.text_original: Dixit et adversos telum contorsit in hostis / procurrens: sonitum dat stridula cornus et auras / certa secat.
source.text_english: He spoke and, running forward, hurled his spear against the foe; the shrill horn gives a sound and cleaves the air with sure aim.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras caede madens?
reuse.text_original: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras / caede madens?
reuse.text_english: What one, dripping with slaughter, cleaves the air with winged serpents?
